# Alyona's Private Tutoring

> Private one-on-one math and science tutoring for secondary students (K–12 & adult education) in Langley, British Columbia, Canada, and surrounding Metro Vancouver / Fraser Valley communities. Taught by Alyona Kosovskykh, a BC Certified Teacher.

## Key facts
- Tutor: Alyona Kosovskykh, BC Certified Teacher
- Education: BSc Biochemistry & Chemistry (University of British Columbia); Bachelor of Education (Simon Fraser University)
- Experience: 7+ years of private tutoring and classroom teaching
- Subjects (K–12 & adult ed): Chemistry 11 & 12, Science K–10, Math K–10, biochemistry, Pre-Calculus 11 & 12, Life Sciences 11, Anatomy & Physiology 12, test prep
- Location: Langley, BC. Also serves Surrey, White Rock, Abbotsford, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Burnaby, New Westminster, Vancouver
- Price: free 30-minute trial lesson; $50 CAD per hour after that
- Approach: personalized lessons, clear explanations, step-by-step practice problems, focus on understanding how and why
